hero.lead: A friendly Wednesday-evening club for entrepreneurial-minded people — you don't need to be an entrepreneur. Practise speaking, get honest feedback, and build a network among people who are building something.

slides.caption: photo: table topics in full swing

about.headline: A supportive room in Metrotown
about.lead: Established on March 1, 2016, The Burnaby Entrepreneurs Toastmasters Club in Metrotown is a supportive community tor people who want to build confidence in communication, public speaking, and leadership.
about.second: With an entrepreneurial mindset, our club welcomes business owners, professionals, creatives, and anyone looking to speak with more clarity and authority. Through mentorship, peer feedback, and hands-on practice, members grow their skills, build meaningful connections, and turn goals into action.
about.callout_lead: Entrepreneurial-minded people. You don't need to be an entrepreneur.
about.callout_sub: For people who want to build a network with entrepreneurs.

members.headline: Three ways members grow every week

cards.title: Prepared Speeches
cards.body: Work through Pathways projects at your own pace, from your icebreaker to a keynote. Every speech gets a written and spoken evaluation.

cards.title: Table Topics
cards.body: One question, one to two minutes, no preparation. The fastest way to get comfortable answering a client, an investor, or a room.

cards.title: Roles & Connections
cards.body: Chair a meeting, mentor a newer member, stay for the after-chat. Leadership practice and a network of people building businesses.

gala.headline: The Burnaby Entrepreneurs Gala
gala.lead: Once a year we put on our best and celebrate the speeches, the awards, and the members behind them. Registration for the next Gala opens later this year — until then, look back at how the last two went.
gala.note: Next year's registration isn't open yet. Attend a Wednesday meeting and we'll tell you first.

attend.headline: Tell us you're coming
attend.lead: Guests sit in, watch, and leave whenever they like — no speaking required on your first visit. Let us know you're planning to come and someone will meet you at the door.
attend.finding_the_room: Winners Community Room, Metropolis at Metrotown, Burnaby. Enter through the two double doors beside Winners.
